name: nightcall
description: Triage a production alert: reproduce what can be reproduced, trace the bad value to its origin, and return a unified diff plus a regression test when code is attached. User code is never executed.
author: alfredoantonio.decandia@gmail.com

tools.name: triage_alert
tools.description: Analyze a production alert. Returns root cause, title-vs-error check, calibrated confidence with reasons, fix plan, a unified diff when code is attached, a regression test, and what to attach for a better answer.

parameters.name: alert
parameters.description: Alert JSON or free text (title, error, service, stack trace)

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Optional: files from the stack, each starting with a line `// file: path/to/file.js`

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Optional: public GitHub repo URL to fetch the files named in the stack

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Optional: branch, tag or commit for repo (default HEAD)
